object: bistable mechanical metamaterial memory beams on rotating platform
problem: How can any bit configuration of a bistable metamaterial be written in a single global drive cycle?
mechanism_or_method: Drive orbits in angular velocity-acceleration space cross designed switching thresholds, addressing each state of a five-bit beam system.
limitation: Only five bits demonstrated; scaling to many bits and other physical domains not shown.

problem: How do interacting filament loops inside vesicles drive vesicle shape transformations?
mechanism_or_method: Theoretical modeling and molecular dynamics simulations yielding morphological phase diagrams of filament-vesicle deformation competition.
limitation: Purely simulated; no experimental validation in artificial cells.
decision_relevance: Design guidance for filament-based shape control in artificial cells.

object: KNN-based piezoelectric ceramics for energy harvesting
problem: How to raise output current of piezoelectric harvesters under operating conditions?
mechanism_or_method: BiFeO3 incorporation creates rhombohedral-tetragonal phase boundary and narrower bandgap, raising piezoelectric response and lowering resistivity.
limitation: Lab-scale ceramic samples; long-term stability and scale-up not addressed.
decision_relevance: Material composition choice for high-current piezo harvesters.

object: magneto-mechano-electric generator with PIN-PMN-PT single crystals
problem: Can Mn-doped single crystals deliver high-power ambient magnetic field harvesting for IoT?
mechanism_or_method: Mn acceptor doping raises mechanical quality factor of Bridgman-grown crystals; finite element analysis guides generator design.
limitation: Single-crystal cost and ambient-field strength dependence not discussed.
decision_relevance: Choose acceptor-doped crystals for battery-free IoT magnetic harvesters.

object: shallow surface-rupturing faults in soft sediments
problem: How does off-fault damage control near-surface rupture slowdown and arrest?
mechanism_or_method: Experiments plus Dead Sea field measurements estimate off-fault energy; analytical rupture modeling shows added fracture energy slows ruptures.
limitation: Based on one field site and analytical model; generality to other sediments unclear.
decision_relevance: Surface rupture hazard assessment for soft-sediment sites.

problem: How can active particles change shape to reconfigure propulsion and steering?
mechanism_or_method: Hydrogel-glassy polymer bilayer prisms curve with temperature, changing polarizability and AC-field-driven linear or helical motion.
limitation: Demonstrated only in controlled AC fields and temperature cycling at microscale.

object: buckling-induced wrinkled surfaces under bacterial flow
problem: Can wrinkled topographies reduce bacterial colonization and biofilm under fluid shear?
mechanism_or_method: Fabricated tunable wrinkles and folds in microfluidic channels, tested with P. aeruginosa and S. aureus across shear rates.
limitation: Short-term microfluidic assays with two species; in vivo device performance untested.
decision_relevance: Surface texture choice for antifouling medical and industrial devices.

problem: How does seismic moment scale with permeability generation from centimeter to subkilometer scales?
mechanism_or_method: Laboratory fault reactivation experiments with absolute moment constraint combined with first-order scaling model to field scale.
limitation: Prefactor spans many decades for natural parameters; relation constrained empirically only partially.
decision_relevance: Using microseismicity to predict permeability in stimulated reservoirs.

problem: How to make e-skin replicating skin composition and architecture with high sensitivity?
mechanism_or_method: Sodium lactate and montmorillonite gelatin gel with sandpaper-templated dermal papillae microstructure in iontronic sensor arrays.
limitation: Hydrogel hydration stability and long-term durability not detailed.

problem: Can electric fields without electrodes contact program polymerization and stiffness in composites?
mechanism_or_method: Piezoelectric ZnO nanoparticles transduce AC fields into thiyl radicals, initiating thiol-ene polymerization with voltage-tunable modulus.
limitation: Chemistry-focused; mechanical performance and field penetration in thick parts not quantified.

problem: How to upcycle carbon fibre waste into higher-value graphene-grafted fibres?
mechanism_or_method: Mg/CaCO3 solid-flame reaction converts epoxy residues to graphene grafted on fibres within seconds.
limitation: Lab-scale batches; mechanical properties of resulting composites only briefly evaluated.
decision_relevance: End-of-life route for carbon fibre composite waste.

problem: How to sustain hydrovoltaic power across -35 to 80 C?
mechanism_or_method: Organic molecules cluster with salt anions, raising water phase-change barrier and easing ion transport.
limitation: Lab hydrogel devices; long-term outdoor operation not shown.

object: laser powder bed fused Fe-Co-V magnetostrictive parts
problem: How to give magnetostrictive parts laser-programmable macroscopic shape change?
mechanism_or_method: Laser stimulation parameters and scan strategies redistribute internal stress, causing local plastic deformation in printed parts.
limitation: Shape-morphing range and repeatability in service environments not established.

problem: Why does pore interconnection harm xylene isomer separation, and can channel isolation fix it?
mechanism_or_method: Barrier ligands installed at interconnecting windows isolate micro and mesopores; confirmed by inverse gas chromatography and molecular dynamics.
limitation: Tested on xylene isomers and two MOFs only.

problem: How can miniature robots move in high-resistance solid-liquid and granular media?
mechanism_or_method: Reciprocal impact oscillation fluidizes surrounding medium, giving up to 3 N force and 13-fold lower resistance.
limitation: Demonstrated in benchtop media; in vivo or field operation not validated.
decision_relevance: Actuation strategy for robots operating in granular or viscous media.

problem: What governs size-dependent deformation of 3D-printed nano-architected metals at 100 nm features?
mechanism_or_method: Two-photon lithography with hydrogel infusion prints Ni; in situ tests and porosity-informed multiscale finite element simulations.
limitation: Small-volume samples; scalability and fatigue behavior not assessed.
decision_relevance: Nanoporosity control in nano-architected metal strength design.

object: electrochemical direct air CO2 capture electrodes
problem: How to suppress O2 side reactions in redox-carrier air CO2 capture?
mechanism_or_method: Thiadiazole carrier BPT combined with ether-oxygen gas permeation layer favors CO2 over O2; supported by molecular dynamics.
limitation: Only 48 cycles at lab scale.

object: LiBH4 trilayered nanocomposite for hydrogen storage
problem: How to enable reversible LiBH4 hydrogen storage at moderate temperature?
mechanism_or_method: Layer-by-layer graphene, Ni nanocluster, LiBH4 nanoparticle assembly; Ni catalyzes B-H bond formation and lowers dissociation barrier.
limitation: Requires 100 bar H2 and cycling durability is limited to lab tests.

problem: How do organic foulants modulate inorganic gypsum scaling at membrane interfaces?
mechanism_or_method: In situ time-resolved synchrotron X-ray scattering in the concentration polarization layer with modelling, spectroscopy and imaging.
limitation: Model foulants and synchrotron access limit realism and replication.
decision_relevance: Anti-scaling strategy selection for desalination membranes.

problem: Can one membrane perform multistage molecular separation by light-switched pore size?
mechanism_or_method: Click-grafted azobenzene in COF nanochannels isomerizes to switch pore size between 0.73 and 0.93 nm.
limitation: Stability shown only for 100 cycles; simulated ore and hemp oil mixtures.

problem: Can active particles navigate hidden flow perturbations through physical embodiment without explicit sensing?
mechanism_or_method: Reinforcement learning controls simulated active particles that exploit information in their dynamics to counteract unobserved flow.
limitation: Simulation only; experimental realization with real microswimmers not shown.

object: heterogeneous hygroscopic organogels for atmospheric water harvesting
problem: How to break the trade-off between water retention and transport in hygroscopic gels?
mechanism_or_method: Hydrophilic pectin shell around hydrophobic graphene oxide core with glycerol enables osmotic pumping and solar desorption.
limitation: Yields measured under controlled humidity and illumination; outdoor durability unclear.

problem: How does solute-solute interaction affect grain boundary segregation and solute drag in multicomponent alloys?
mechanism_or_method: Theoretical and computational framework coupling multiple dopants to a migrating boundary, showing cosegregation and desegregation effects.
limitation: No experimental validation against doped multicomponent alloys.
decision_relevance: Alloy chemistry selection to control grain growth via solute drag.

problem: How do C-F and C-Cl bonds jointly enhance tribo-negative performance?
mechanism_or_method: Chlorine plasma tunes surface Cl/F ratio; C-Cl lowers LUMO for electron capture while C-F retains charge.
limitation: Charge density measured on lab devices; environmental stability not covered.

object: phase change composite fibers with macro-channels
problem: Can convection in molten PCM channels beat conduction fillers for thermal management?
mechanism_or_method: Core/shell fibers made by non-solvent-induced phase separation with channel architectures enabling convective heat transfer.
limitation: Apparent conductivity only 1.05 W/m/K; orientation and long-cycling effects not detailed.
decision_relevance: Channel design for passive electronics thermal buffering.

object: bipolar membrane electrodialysis with synthetic urine
problem: Does oversimplified synthetic urine misrepresent membrane fouling mechanisms and economics?
mechanism_or_method: Compared full-component and simplified urine formulations over seven batches with molecular dynamics and characterization.
limitation: Still synthetic urine, not real urine, and only seven batches.
decision_relevance: Choice of wastewater formulation in lab testing of membranes.

problem: How do Ru/RuOx interfaces steer selectivity in lignin hydrodeoxygenation?
mechanism_or_method: Thermal restructuring of CNF hydroxyls forms polarized Ru/RuOx sites; XAS, NAP-XPS and DFT show cooperative H2 and C-O activation.
limitation: Hydrocarbon yield of 49 percent mass; catalyst stability and real lignin variability unclear.

object: North American wildfire diurnal burning hours
problem: Has weakening diurnal weather constraint lengthened wildfire burning hours?
mechanism_or_method: Hourly geostationary satellite data for about 9000 fires plus fire-weather reconstruction of potential burning hours 1975-2024.
limitation: Potential burning hours derived from weather proxies; satellite detection limited to large fires.
decision_relevance: Firefighting shift planning for longer, night-active fires.

object: molten carbonate CO2 electroreduction to carbon
problem: What intermediates form during molten salt CO2-to-carbon electroreduction?
mechanism_or_method: High-temperature operando Raman spectroelectrochemistry detects peroxide O2 2- and tracks carbon structure on several electrodes.
limitation: Intermediate identified spectroscopically; G-peak shift origin remains ambiguous.

problem: Can fully continuous fibre lattices reach foam-like density with bulk-level strength?
mechanism_or_method: 3D node winding guided by algorithmic design controls fibre continuity per unit cell, giving pseudo-ductile progressive failure.
limitation: Winding process manual-scale; fatigue and impact performance not reported.
decision_relevance: Lattice architecture choice for lightweight structural frames such as drones.

problem: How to adhere reversibly and strongly to diverse changing plant surfaces?
mechanism_or_method: Biopolymer forming dynamic covalent bonds with plant surfaces within cross-linked polyacrylamide gives adaptable reversible adhesion.
limitation: Tested on limited plant species and short durations.

object: ultralow-density rigid network hydrogel solar evaporators
problem: How to sustain hydrogel solar evaporation under extreme irradiance?
mechanism_or_method: Rigid anti-shrinkage network preserves hierarchical pores and steep osmotic gradients for ultrafast water supply.
limitation: Salt fouling and long-term outdoor operation beyond 100 h unclear.

problem: How to build a sustainable mechanochromic elastomer from cellulose?
mechanism_or_method: Salting-induced Hofmeister effect tunes hydrogen bonding in chiral nematic HPC, controlling elasticity and structural color shift.
limitation: Water-dependent elasticity may limit stability in dry or varying humidity conditions.

problem: Can one ingestible device sense gastric pH and sample fluid in vivo?
mechanism_or_method: Magnetically actuated body navigates stomach; RF-triggered shape memory actuator draws fluid; hydrogel with metal disks gives ultrasound pH readout.
limitation: Animal models only; 35 microliter sample volume and human translation untested.

problem: How does spin-state regulation improve seawater oxidation in high-entropy oxides?
mechanism_or_method: Jahn-Teller Cu2+ and Mn3+ drive Fe3+/Co3+ to high spin, favoring OH- adsorption and repelling Cl-.
limitation: Lab electrolyzer tests of about 1200 h; real seawater impurities and scale-up open.

problem: Can uncertainty-aware machine learning discover exceptionally hard bulk metallic glasses under limited data?
mechanism_or_method: VIBANN attention-based variational information bottleneck network guides inverse design; five alloys synthesized and analyzed with molecular dynamics.
limitation: Hardness reported only for 2 mm rods; toughness and glass stability not addressed.
decision_relevance: Composition candidates for ultra-hard metallic glass coatings and tools.

object: amine-captured CO2 electrolysis in carbamate solution
problem: Can amine-captured liquid CO2 be directly electroreduced efficiently?
mechanism_or_method: Piperazine carbamate with Ni catalyst and designed gas-liquid-solid interface, verified carbamate participation and scaled 9 cm2 electrolyzer.
limitation: Energy efficiency only 15-25 percent and 150 h stability at small scale.

object: nanosheet proton-conducting membranes for fuel cells
problem: How to achieve high proton conductivity in anhydrous membranes at high temperature?
mechanism_or_method: Nanosheets bridged by nanoconfined phosphoric acid enable through-sheet conduction plus hydrogen-bond hopping, in PEI graphene/boron nitride bilayer.
limitation: Phosphoric acid leaching and long-term stability at 250 C not detailed.

problem: How to mechanically drive elastocaloric elements efficiently with work recovery?
mechanism_or_method: Cam-disc drive with four phase-shifted elements gives constant torque and direct work recovery of about 70 percent.
limitation: 88 percent recovery only from simulation; full cooling system performance not shown.
decision_relevance: Drive mechanism design for elastocaloric refrigeration devices.

problem: Can a single transducer with metamaterials produce highly directional audio?
mechanism_or_method: Co-designed acoustic metasurface and elastic meta-units on one piezoelectric driver yield broadband directional sound via nonlinear acoustics.
limitation: Laboratory prototype; sound level and listener-scale performance not detailed.
decision_relevance: Replace phased arrays with single-transducer metamaterial design for directional audio.

problem: Can a biodegradable low-voltage actuator achieve high energy density and fast response?
mechanism_or_method: PEG network in microfibrillated cellulose suppresses crystallinity and ionic liquid aggregation, boosting ion transport.
limitation: Response time of 1 s still slow; ionic liquid biocompatibility long-term unclear.

object: dynamic evaporative and radiative cooling device
problem: How to get year-round energy savings from passive cooling in four-season regions?
mechanism_or_method: Device adaptively regulates water evaporation and solar/thermal radiation modulation with temperature, evaluated by experiments and energy simulations.
limitation: Water consumption and durability not addressed; savings are simulated.
decision_relevance: Choice of adaptive cooling skin for building energy savings.

problem: How to get high-resolution real-time tactile sensing without computational latency?
mechanism_or_method: Stretchable Bragg reflector between silicone layers encodes strain directly as structural color for vision-based readout.
limitation: Needs camera and illumination; quantitative pressure calibration and durability not shown.

object: high-entropy carbide ceramics for electromagnetic absorption
problem: Does local chemical order govern electromagnetic absorption in high-entropy ceramics?
mechanism_or_method: Thermal processing tunes local chemical order, characterized by atomic-resolution mapping and simulations, reaching 11.2 GHz absorption bandwidth.
limitation: Powder absorbers measured in lab; mechanical and environmental robustness not covered.

object: Knudsen gas transport in disordered porous materials
problem: Can gas permeability in random nanoporous networks be predicted from mean pore size and porosity?
mechanism_or_method: Generalized Knudsen theory validated by Monte Carlo on 5000 random networks and non-equilibrium molecular dynamics.
limitation: Agreement shown only for weakly adsorbing gases; strong adsorption not covered.
decision_relevance: Quick permeability screening of nanoporous membrane materials.

object: high-entropy M-type ferrites for millimeter-wave absorption
problem: How to get broadband thin millimeter-wave absorbers from single-phase high-entropy ferrites?
mechanism_or_method: Iron deficiency raises entropy to eliminate impurity phases, while Zr4+ doping broadens magnetic loss.
limitation: Narrow frequency window near 35 GHz; scalable processing not shown.

problem: How to recover indium tin from spent ITO with high purity and low pollution?
mechanism_or_method: Anodic charge-induced oxygen vacancy formation releases In and Sn ions that deposit as alloy at the cathode.
limitation: Hundred-ampere trial only; long-run electrolyte reuse economics not given.

object: triboelectric vibration energy harvester sensing node
problem: Can one node harvest vibration energy and sense vibration at high rate self-powered?
mechanism_or_method: Multi-contact triboelectric harvester with 10-300 Hz bandwidth doubles as sensor; random forest classifies flange conditions.
limitation: Field tests limited to marine engines and generators; long-term durability of contacts unreported.
decision_relevance: Battery-free vibration monitoring for machinery condition assessment.

object: HP Multi Jet Fusion 3D printing fusing agent
problem: How to make white or bright colored parts with Multi Jet Fusion despite dark absorbers?
mechanism_or_method: Nickel dithiolene NIR dye that photothermally bleaches to colorless after absorbing printing energy.
limitation: Mechanical properties of colored parts and dye cost not discussed in abstract.
decision_relevance: Fusing agent choice for colored powder bed fusion parts.

problem: Does premelting and surface melting occur in glasses as in crystals?
mechanism_or_method: Vapour-deposited stable colloidal glass layers imaged by particle tracking to measure surface liquid and glassy layer growth.
limitation: Colloidal model system; applicability to molecular glasses is inferred.

object: frictional aging of polymer rough interfaces
problem: Can frictional aging be predicted from bulk relaxation measurements?
mechanism_or_method: Show normalized asperity stress relaxation equals bulk relaxation, enabling aging prediction for polypropylene and PTFE.
limitation: Only two polymers tested; metals and ceramics not covered.
decision_relevance: Predict static friction growth from bulk material tests.

problem: Can fracture surface topography quantitatively match forensic fragments?
mechanism_or_method: Spectral analysis of 3D microscopy topography with multivariate statistical learning classifies match versus non-match.
limitation: Laboratory-fractured specimens; real-world forensic variability and error rates need broader validation.
decision_relevance: Quantified matching of forensic fracture evidence.

object: model glass former at low temperature
problem: What structural order emerges as a glass approaches low-temperature equilibrium?
mechanism_or_method: Simulations of a crystallization-free model with particle-size swap reveal compositional network and patch ordering.
limitation: Single model system; relevance to real glasses uncertain.

problem: What makes epithelial folding irreversible?
mechanism_or_method: Indentation assay shows curvature- and duration-dependent elastoplastic switch via TRPC3/6 and EGFR signaling building an F-actin bracket.
limitation: Cultured epithelial model; in vivo tissue generality not shown.

problem: Can capillary-controlled soft fins make ultralow-power switchable displays and textures?
mechanism_or_method: Bimorphic fins switch between straight and bent equilibria via droplet control, with decoupled optical and infrared signals.
limitation: Small pixel arrays; switching speed and durability not reported.

object: acoustic beam shaping with linear array transducer
problem: How to generate propagation-invariant acoustic beams with arbitrary profiles for elasticity imaging?
mechanism_or_method: Wave number modulation and beam multiplexing with attenuation compensation in a linear array transducer.
limitation: Demonstrated in phantoms; clinical tissue performance not established.

problem: How to get on-demand Poisson's ratio together with pre-tension induced compression in sandwich composites?
mechanism_or_method: Kinematically constrained 3D suture tiles with tooth-channel pairs analyzed analytically, numerically and on 3D printed specimens.
limitation: 3D printed polymer specimens only; fatigue and wide-range Poisson's ratio experimentally limited.
decision_relevance: Tile geometry selection for tunable auxetic and strength behavior.

problem: Can ion solvation switching harvest low-frequency kinetic energy electrochemically?
mechanism_or_method: Identical Prussian blue analogue electrodes moved between immiscible electrolytes; solvation free energy difference drives voltage and current.
limitation: Peak power only 6.4 microwatt per square centimeter; long-term cycling beyond 23 cycles unknown.

problem: How do simple geometric linking constraints produce functional behaviors in active collectives?
mechanism_or_method: V-shaped active bots linked into chains whose few link parameters tune locomotion, navigation, and load transport.
limitation: Macroscopic tabletop prototypes; scaling to smaller sizes unproven.

object: locally resonant ultrasonic metafluid with soft metallic beads
problem: Can 3D Anderson localization of classical scalar waves be observed?
mechanism_or_method: Time- and position-resolved ultrasonic experiments in a bead suspension metafluid determine mobility edges and localization phase diagram.
limitation: Single bead-suspension system; practical use of localization not demonstrated.
